answer: Before a reef survey voyage, the buyer escrows one bounty per map tile. The ledger checks the buyer’s signature on the tile ID and the accepted sonar echo file hash, then releases that tile’s bounty only once. Sending the same survey under fifty names earns a single payment. An attacker seeking fifty payouts from real buyers must deliver fifty commissioned tiles and cover the vessel time and fuel. Self-funded orders only recycle the attacker’s own money.
